title: JELLY SUB
oneLiner: Pilot a tiny submarine through swaying jellyfish gates without getting zapped.
mechanics: Tap A to boost the submarine upward; release to dive.
Thread through gaps between pairs of jellyfish to score.
Touching a jellyfish or the top or bottom ends the run.
Jellyfish sway faster and gaps tighten as your score rises.
lose: The submarine loses when it hits a jellyfish, the seabed, or the surface.
scoring: Score one point for each jellyfish gate passed.
